Frequently asked questions
An AI hiring platform helps organizations identify qualified candidates more efficiently by combining automation with skills-based evaluation. Hirevue joins automation with skills-based evaluation and brings together AI Interviewer, video interviewing, validated assessments, workflow automation, and predictive insights to help recruiters make faster, more informed hiring decisions while maintaining transparency and human oversight.
A video interview platform or video interview software enables organizations to evaluate candidates through structured interviews without requiring everyone to meet live. Hirevue’s video interviewing platform helps hiring teams assess skills consistently, streamline scheduling, and create a more efficient hiring experience for both recruiters and candidates.
AI interviewing uses artificial intelligence to guide structured candidate conversations and surface insights that help recruiters evaluate skills more efficiently. Hirevue AI Interviewer conducts dynamic, voice-based interviews that focus on job-relevant competencies, giving hiring teams meaningful insights while keeping people in control of final hiring decisions.
Traditional video interviewing records or facilitates conversations between candidates and employers. AI interviewing builds on that experience by using AI to guide structured interviews, adapt follow-up questions, and surface skills-based insights that help recruiters prioritize qualified candidates more efficiently.
Candidate assessment software, also known as talent assessment software or pe-employment assessment software, helps employers evaluate job-related skills, competencies, and potential beyond what a resume can show. Hirevue combines validated assessments with structured interviews and predictive insights to help organizations identify candidates who are more likely to succeed on the job.
Hirevue helps organizations streamline every stage of hiring—from candidate engagement and AI-powered screening to interviewing, assessments, scheduling, and selection. As hourly hiring software for high-volume employers and a hiring platform for professional roles, Hirevue helps recruiters identify qualified candidates earlier, reduce manual work, and improve hiring quality and consistency.
Yes. When built on validated hiring science, AI can help recruiters screen candidates more efficiently by focusing on relevant skills rather than resume formatting or keywords alone. Hirevue combines AI with structured evaluations and predictive insights to help teams prioritize qualified talent with greater confidence.
Responsible AI hiring requires transparency, governance, and scientific validation. Hirevue designs its AI solutions to support fairer, explainable hiring through structured evaluations, validated assessment methods, and enterprise-grade governance practices that help organizations meet compliance and regulatory requirements.
Organizations across healthcare, retail, manufacturing, financial services, hospitality, government, and many other industries use Hirevue to hire at scale. Whether filling high-volume frontline roles or specialized professional positions, Hirevue talent acquisition software helps employers identify qualified talent faster through skills-based hiring.
Hirevue integrates with many leading applicant tracking systems (ATS) and HR platforms, allowing recruiting teams to incorporate video interviewing, assessments, AI Interviewer, and hiring workflows into their existing recruiting processes. This helps create a more connected and efficient hiring experience without disrupting established systems.
Hirevue predictive insights combine validated assessment results with structured interview data to help recruiters identify candidates who are more likely to succeed in a role. The insights are grounded in hiring science, providing explainable recommendations that support—not replace—human decision-making.
No. Hirevue is designed to help recruiters spend less time on repetitive administrative work and more time engaging with qualified candidates. AI supports screening, interviewing, and insights, while recruiters remain responsible for evaluating candidates and making final hiring decisions.
